summary.text: Michael Benedetto is the incumbent Democratic Assembly Member for District 82 in the northeast Bronx, first elected in 2004. A lifelong northeast Bronx resident, he spent 35 years as a teacher, mostly in special education at P.S. 160 in Co-op City, and founded the Bronx Times Reporter newspaper. He chairs the Assembly's Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michael Benedetto was born in the Bronx in 1947 and has lived his entire life in the northeast Bronx.
He attended local Catholic schools, then graduated from Iona College in 1969 with a B.A. in history and education, serving as president of the student council there.
He earned an M.A. in social studies and education in 1971.
He taught at Our Lady of Assumption School in Pelham Bay from 1969 to 1974, then joined the New York City public schools in 1974 as a teacher of mentally and physically challenged children.
He was assigned to P.S. 160 in Co-op City in 1977 and became coordinator of its special-education unit in 1988, remaining there for almost 28 years until his election to the Assembly in 2004.
His official biography lists teaching awards, including a 1993 Federation of Italian-American Educators Excellence in Teaching Award.
Ballotpedia lists him as an adjunct instructor at Mercy College.
Outside the classroom, Benedetto started the Throggs Neck Community Players community theater group in 1969 and served on Community Planning Board #10 from 1975 to 1979.
In 1981 he started the Bronx Times Reporter newspaper, which his official biography describes as the largest community paper in the Bronx.
He also served on the staffs of City Councilmembers Michael DeMarco and Madeline Provenzano before his election to the Assembly, according to the same biography.
Benedetto was elected to the Assembly in 2004 and took office in 2005.
As of the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Education Committee and also sits on the Labor Committee.
In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he describes himself as a lifelong East Bronx resident, born and raised in the Country Club community, who lives in Throggs Neck and is a father and grandfather.
